dedupe_keys.name: sub surface thermal loop sstl for data centre cooling version 2 0

description: The project author publishes an open-hardware concept for a subsurface thermal loop intended to cool data centres. Zenodo provides a component CSV, system diagrams and a short README under CC BY 4.0. The documents outline a closed-loop thermosiphon, possible reuse of existing wells and candidate component ratings. These materials can supply an explicitly hypothetical equipment configuration for early cooling and heat-rejection simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this component specification. Coverage is a proposed architecture, with no demonstrated full-scale operating site. A limitation is that the README calls the design an initial engineering concept requiring professional review, site-specific analysis and regulatory approval. Its claimed passive circulation and performance have not been independently validated; a referenced manuscript is absent from the public Zenodo file list. The CSV and diagrams were not downloaded, and no thermofluid calculation was checked.
